APPLICATION PLANNING

Recommended Uses

LED cup

Outdoor Bars ↗

An acrylic cup with LED light in the base or wall: Switched on for service and off in one pass at close.

Tailgate & Car Parties ↗

When the tailgate runs past sunset, a lit cup is easy to spot across the lot.

Corporate Events & Branded Gifts ↗

A giveaway that gets remembered the moment it lights up, logo included.

Confirm for your project

Check service speed, stacking storage and lighting after dark；venue container rules, pour size and how it travels in the car；the printable area, what goes in the set and how it is packed.

These are selection suggestions. Review the chosen configuration and sample against your intended use.
